name: cfg-provider-retry-invalid
about: retry 各键的非法值（parseModelConfig.ts:170-190：非数、负数、非有限数报 MODEL_INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE，该 provider 被排除，loadPilotConfig.ts:702-709 记 warning）；retry 不是对象时整段忽略（parseRetryConfig 返回 undefined，provider 仍可用）。比 resolve_settings 的 diagnostics 与 model_catalog_list，以及服务启动输出。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    r1:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        requestMaxRetries: -1
      models:
        m: {}
    r2:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: "2"
      models:
        m: {}
    r3:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: .inf
      models:
        m: {}
    r4:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        maxStreamingDurationMs: true
      models:
        m: {}
    r5:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        repeatedChunkLimit: [3]
      models:
        m: {}
    r6:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        baseDelayMs: -0.5
      models:
        m: {}
    r7:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        maxDelayMs: null
      models:
        m: {}
    r8:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        jitter: {a: 1}
      models:
        m: {}
    r9:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry: 5
      models:
        m: {}
telemetry:
  enabled: false
